text: An immutable blockchain log of transactions and modifications inside AI systems lets stakeholders trace the lineage of an AI decision back to its original data inputs, which makes errors easier to identify and correct.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Governance Via Web3 Reputation System (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4941807

isBasedOn.name: AI Governance Via Web3 Reputation System

abstract: This feature allows stakeholders to track the lineage of AI decisions back to their original data inputs, enabling easier identification and correction of errors.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: where AI data inputs and modifications are recorded on an immutable ledger
